verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly has a dedicated first-party Approvals docs page under releases. Its environments, role assignment and change history pages are the natural surrounding controls for gating production flag changes behind review. The evidence is only page titles, though, so how approvals are enforced is not shown. Missing for 10: detailed evidence that approvals can be made mandatory per environment (e.g. production only), external change-request system integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
